about.title: How Wordverse Works | Word Galaxies and Data Backups
about.metaDescription: Learn how Wordverse turns vocabulary into stars, organizes languages in galaxies, and keeps your data backed up.
about.ogDescription: Quick answers about word stars, language galaxies, and data backups.
about.ogImageAlt: Blue and violet nebula in dark space
about.lead: Wordverse is an interactive galaxy that grows with the words you learn. Give English, Spanish, or any language you are starting its own sky. Every word is born as a star.

steps.title: 01 · Choose a galaxy
steps.body: An English galaxy and an empty Spanish galaxy are ready for you. Create as many galaxies as you need for other languages.

steps.title: 02 · Add a word
steps.body: Enter the word and its meaning. A new word is born as a white star, and the nebula grows with your vocabulary.

steps.title: 03 · Explore
steps.body: Hover over a star to see its word. To reveal the meaning, select the eye icon in its detail panel.

steps.title: 04 · Back up
steps.body: A second local copy is saved automatically. Download a JSON backup from the galaxy panel and restore it in another browser.

faq.question: Where are my words stored?
faq.answer: Your guest universe stays in this site’s browser storage and a second local copy. After signing in, choose whether to merge it or open only your account universe. Account content syncs with Supabase when connected; offline edits wait on your device. Clearing browser data may remove local copies, so keep separate JSON backups.

faq.question: Do the stars really age?
faq.answer: New stars appear white. The days since you learned a word are represented by a compressed visual life cycle that shifts toward warmer colors. This is not an astronomical time simulation; real star colors depend mainly on temperature and mass.

faq.question: Why do the two oldest stars orbit together?
faq.answer: The two oldest words in each galaxy move around a shared center of mass, like a binary star system. This gives those words a visual emphasis; it does not mean they have physically become neutron stars.

faq.question: How do I navigate my galaxy?
faq.answer: Drag with a mouse and use the wheel to zoom. On touchscreens, use two fingers to zoom. The four-corner icon on the right hides the text and panels so you can view only the universe.

about.planetsBody: In the same galaxy, words live as stars and conjunctions as planets. Each planet keeps one selected texture from Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, or Neptune, even after reloading. The maps come from NASA/JPL-Caltech and USGS. Some gas giant maps are visual approximations of changing atmospheres and are not intended for scientific analysis.
about.note: Wordverse is a vocabulary atlas and an artistic visualization. Physical sizes and timescales are adapted for interaction.

legal.privacyLead: A clear explanation of where your data stays and what you share through an account.
legal.termsLead: Wordverse is a free, evolving learning journal and artistic universe visualization.
privacySections: The data controller for Wordverse is Mustafa Kılıç. Contact kopukfad@gmail.com for project questions, personal-data enquiries and requests to exercise your rights.

Words, meanings, galaxies and history stay in this site’s browser storage (IndexedDB and localStorage). Guest content is not automatically uploaded. Clearing browser data can remove local copies; keep a separate JSON backup.

Creating an account sends your email and password to Supabase for authentication. We do not put passwords in application documents or logs. Session information is stored on your device. When Google sign-in is enabled, the basic profile and email information shown on Google’s permission screen are used to identify your account.

Choosing cloud sync stores your universe in Supabase under your account. Account-universe edits sync when connected; offline changes wait in the IndexedDB queue on this device. The Supabase project region is Singapore; Vercel hosts the site. These providers may process technical data such as IP addresses for service delivery and security. The legal basis and safeguards for transfers outside Turkey or the European Economic Area must be documented before general cloud use.

Account data supports the sign-in service you request, session security and abuse prevention. Universe content is used only for the sync service you choose. We do not sell data or build advertising profiles; the app uses no marketing cookies or independent analytics. Account data remains while the account is active; deletion requests are processed after identity verification. Provider log and backup retention periods still need to be specified.

Export or import a JSON backup from the galaxy panel. Where applicable under KVKK or GDPR, you may request information, access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection and portability, and complain to the competent supervisory authority. Send requests to the contact address. We ask only for information needed to verify your identity; never send your password. Signing out does not erase your local universe.
termsSections: Use Wordverse to record, explore and review vocabulary. Add only content you have the right to use; avoid other people’s private or sensitive information. Do not access other accounts, bypass security or abuse the service.

You retain rights to your content. Optional cloud storage is used only to store your account’s content and sync it between your devices. Download JSON backups regularly; do not rely only on this site during browser cleanup or service interruptions.

Choose a strong, unique password. Keep verification and recovery links private. Guest mode is free and requires no account. Account deletion requests go to the contact address; another person’s data is not deleted without verification.

Visualizations are artistic interpretations; time and scale are adapted for interaction. Wordverse does not guarantee learning outcomes, scientific measurement accuracy or uninterrupted service. Your mandatory legal rights remain unaffected.

These terms may change as the project develops. Material changes to data processing are explained before they take effect. You will not be automatically enrolled in a paid service. Project questions and data requests: kopukfad@gmail.com.
